messages.author: f633c04bcd9cdcec
messages.subject: Lavaan for latent class analysis
parts:
Dear group,

I have been looking at a way to perform a latent class analysis without having to buy a license for Mplus, and hoped that lavaan would be my solution.

I want to do an analysis where my indicators are a mix between categorical and continuous variables. I have found several packages that can do a latent class analysis with just categorical indicators, and some packages that can do latent profile analysis with just continuous ones, but I haven't been able to find a way to combine both.

Is this possible in Lavaan and if yes, how?

Thanks in advance,

Nikki van Eijk

messages.author: 82889e926eb5165e
messages.subject: Re: Lavaan for latent class analysis
parts:
lavaan does not do latent class analysis.

Some R packages might work are flexmix, depmixS4. I am sure you can specify continuous and categorical items in the same model

If you need to use propietary software, LatentGold is better for this type of models
